title: PMSM Current Controller with Pre-Control
text: 带预控制的离散时间永磁同步电机电流控制器，输入 5 路、输出 1 路；按 {Axis prioritization} 指定电压限幅器的轴优先级；{D-axis current proportional gain} 指定 D 轴比例增益、{D-axis current integral gain} 指定 D 轴积分增益、{D-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 D 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Q-axis current proportional gain} 指定 Q 轴比例增益、{Q-axis current integral gain} 指定 Q 轴积分增益、{Q-axis current anti-windup gain} 指定 Q 轴抗积分饱和增益、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定模块采样时间、{Enable zero cancellation} 指定前馈零点对消、{Enable pre-control voltage} 指定预控制电压、{D-axis current vector, id (A)} 指定 D 轴电流断点向量、{Q-axis current vector, iq (A)} 指定 Q 轴电流断点向量、{Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)} 指定 D 轴电感查找表数据 0.0002 * ones、{Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)} 指定 Q 轴电感查找表数据 0.0002 * ones、{Permanent magnet flux linkage matrix, PM(id,iq) (Wb)} 指定磁链查找表数据 0.04 * ones，按实例取值。

params.name: D-axis current proportional gain
params.values: D 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: D-axis current integral gain
params.values: D 轴积分增益 100 (default) | positive number

params.name: D-axis current anti-windup gain
params.values: D 轴抗积分饱和增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current proportional gain
params.values: Q 轴比例增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current integral gain
params.values: Q 轴积分增益 100 (default) | positive number

params.name: Q-axis current anti-windup gain
params.values: Q 轴抗积分饱和增益 1 (default) | positive number

params.name: Sample time (-1 for inherited)
params.values: 模块采样时间 -1 (default) | -1 or positive number

params.name: Axis prioritization
params.values: 电压限幅器的轴优先级 q-axis (default) | d-axis | d-q equivalence

params.name: Enable zero cancellation
params.values: 前馈零点对消 off (default) | on

params.name: D-axis current vector, id (A)
params.values: D 轴电流断点向量 [-200,0,200] A (default) | monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Q-axis current vector, iq (A)
params.values: Q 轴电流断点向量 [-200,0,200] A (default) | monotonically increasing vector

params.name: Ld matrix, Ld(id,iq) (H)
params.values: D 轴电感查找表数据 0.0002 * ones(3, 3) H (default) | positive matrix

params.name: Lq matrix, Lq(id,iq) (H)
params.values: Q 轴电感查找表数据 0.0002 * ones(3, 3) H (default) | positive matrix

params.name: Permanent magnet flux linkage matrix, PM(id,iq) (Wb)
params.values: 磁链查找表数据 0.04 * ones(3, 3) Wb (default) | real matrix
